resources.string: Associated adult circulation overview. Blue and red indicate relatively oxygen-poor and oxygen-rich blood, not actual blood colors. Arrows show direction; animation time is not blood-flow speed. Chambers, valves and capillary beds are simplified.

Body tissues → systemic veins → right atrium and ventricle → pulmonary arteries → lungs → pulmonary veins → left atrium and ventricle → systemic arteries → body tissues. Lung and tissue exchange are not numerically modeled.
